facts.en: Completed a jewellery-making apprenticeship at Fictional Silverpetal Guild in 2012.
facts.zh: 2012 年在虚构银瓣行会完成珠宝制作学徒培训。

facts.en: Paid bench jeweller at Fictional Mossring Studio from 2012-08 to 2018-02.
facts.zh: 2012-08 至 2018-02 在虚构苔戒工作室任有薪珠宝台工。

facts.en: Paid senior bench jeweller at Fictional Lindenclasp Works from 2018-03 to 2022-08.
facts.zh: 2018-03 至 2022-08 在虚构椴扣工坊任有薪高级珠宝台工。

facts.en: Paid bench team leader at the same workshop from 2022-09 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-09 至 2026-08 在同一工坊任有薪台工团队负责人。

facts.en: Line-manages 2 junior bench staff and allocates approved fabrication and finishing jobs.
facts.zh: 直接管理 2 名初级台工，并分配获批制作及表面处理工单。

facts.en: Fabricates simple silver pendants from approved drawings and checks dimensions against the work specification.
facts.zh: 依据获批图纸制作简式银吊坠，并按作业规格核对尺寸。

facts.en: Prepares approved components for joining and finishes surfaces using the workshop’s documented procedures.
facts.zh: 依据工坊有文档记录的程序准备待连接的获批组件，并进行表面处理。

facts.en: Records metal issued, returned offcuts and completed piece counts on separate job-sheet fields.
facts.zh: 在工单不同字段分别记录领用金属、退回边角料及完成件数。

facts.en: The workshop owner approves customer designs and pricing; an external service performs formal metal assay and hallmarking.
facts.zh: 工坊所有者批准客户设计及价格；正式金属成色检验及认证印记的打制由外部服务机构完成。

facts.en: Led bench scheduling for a 2025-04 order of 30 approved silver pendants.
facts.zh: 2025-04 牵头安排一批 30 件获批银吊坠订单的台工作业。

facts.en: Personally fabricated 12 pieces and checked dimensions on the team’s other 18 pieces.
facts.zh: 个人制作 12 件，并核对团队其余 18 件的尺寸。

facts.en: The final workshop record lists all 30 pieces completed; it does not record customer receipt or sales revenue.
facts.zh: 最终工坊记录列明全部 30 件完成；未记录客户签收或销售收入。

facts.en: Separates pieces needing further surface work from items ready for owner inspection.
facts.zh: 将需进一步表面处理的作品与可供工坊所有者检查的作品分开。

facts.en: Uses bench measuring tools, approved design drawings and spreadsheet job tracking.
facts.zh: 使用台工测量工具、获批设计图及电子表格工单跟踪。

facts.en: Completed internal supervisor and workshop incident-reporting training in 2022-10.
facts.zh: 2022-10 完成内部主管及工坊事件上报培训。

facts.en: Demonstrates approved finishing steps to junior staff and records supervised-practice sign-offs.
facts.zh: 向初级员工示范获批表面处理步骤，并记录受监督练习的签署确认。

facts.en: Volunteers with Fictional Copperleaf Craft Circle, teaching simple wire-shape exercises using nonprecious craft wire.
facts.zh: 在虚构铜叶手工社做志愿者，使用非贵金属手工线材教授简单线形练习。

facts.en: Created a personal paper-and-thread necklace in 2024 for a club costume display.
facts.zh: 2024 年为社团服装展示制作个人纸与线项链。

facts.en: The necklace contained no gemstones or precious metals and was not offered for commercial sale.
facts.zh: 该项链不含宝石或贵金属，亦未用于商业销售。

facts.en: Enjoys drawing knot patterns and carving decorative soap shapes.
facts.zh: 爱好绘制结绳图案及雕刻装饰皂形。

facts.en: Maintains handovers for unfinished pieces, material returns and customer changes awaiting owner approval.
facts.zh: 维护交接，列明未完成作品、材料退回及待工坊所有者批准的客户变更。

facts.en: No gemstone grading qualification or independent precious-metal certification authority is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录宝石分级资格或独立贵金属认证权限。
